algorithms.name: SRECE (noise-covariance weighting)
algorithms.result: lite form (per-overpass background-annulus noise -> 1/sigma^2 weights, with monsoon exclusion): part of the combined method that lifts every known emitter above 3 sigma (R4: +wind 5.9 -> combined 5.4 t/h floor). Variogram/correlation-length form not built.

algorithms.name: ABD (albedo/aerosol bias decorrelation)
algorithms.result: mean z over 5 emitters 3.74 -> 4.06; floor 5.4 -> 5.0 t/h

algorithms.name: PW-HHP (Helmholtz projection of winds)
algorithms.result: national noise fell 29% but blind recovery fell 4 -> 3 of 4 (Jawaharnagar lost). Unweighted variant: the gridded product has no column-mass per wind.

algorithms.name: NDC (null-divergence wind calibration)
algorithms.result: replaced by per-site ERA5 100 m/10 m transport factor (gamma) + OBC slope, which are independently measurable

algorithms.name: MSFD (multi-species flux divergence)
algorithms.result: CO leg built (same pixels, winds, operator; CO detected above its own null at all 5 emitters); NO2 not ingested

algorithms.name: KPW (Kuttaka phase-weighted stacking)
algorithms.result: superseded: footprint drizzle samples every sub-pixel phase directly, so phase re-weighting has nothing left to fix

algorithms.name: PSSI (sparse + smooth physics-prior inversion)
algorithms.result: needs paddy (Sentinel-1 SAR/EVI) and livestock priors that are not ingested; the local plane background + monsoon exclusion does the separation in the current method

algorithms.name: DiverSR (divergence super-resolution)
algorithms.result: core (footprint-drizzled super-resolved stacking) validated in R4 (combined vs +wind); off-grid peak refinement FAILED: mean blind distance 7.9 -> 8.7 km

algorithms.name: WIT (wind-invariance test)
algorithms.result: false-reject rate 21% on centred injections (needs <= 15%); power 8% against a neighbour at the disk edge (needs >= 50%). Divergence within a disk is already nearly wind-invariant.

algorithms.name: MRI (monsoon residual imputation)
algorithms.result: policy adopted without the imputation: monsoon months are reported as unobserved, never filled

algorithms.name: MC-FOD (moisture-coupled landfill decay)
algorithms.result: needs soil-moisture and waste-input series per landfill

algorithms.name: PKTD (process-kernel temporal decomposition)
algorithms.result: per-site monthly series are too sparse after monsoon exclusion (0-12 overpasses/month)

algorithms.name: EIV-CRF (CO/CH4 ratio fingerprint)
algorithms.result: ratio separated from the combustion boundary at 2 of 5 emitters (deonar, jharia); gate needs 3

algorithms.name: EFA (evidence-fusion attribution)
algorithms.result: no facility registry ingested yet; sectors are given only for cited reference facilities

algorithms.name: OBC (injection-recovery calibration)
algorithms.result: recovery slope 0.989 (R^2 0.9998, site CV 0.5%); detection probability 5 t/h: 8%, 10 t/h: 46%, 20 t/h: 100%, 40 t/h: 100%

algorithms.name: BY-FDR inventory gate
algorithms.result: site form: 0 of 36 fake candidates admitted (size OK, p-values uniform KS p=0.43); conservative power: 2 of 5 emitters confirmed in a 42-site family. National-grid form: 0 discoveries (local minima are as deep as maxima, so the screen is a lead list, not an inventory).

algorithms.name: WRPI (warming-per-rupee priority)
algorithms.result: transparent accounting over cited constants (AR6 GWP20, EPA landfill MAC, IEA fossil MAC) with Monte Carlo; x P(real)

algorithms.name: VOIT (value-of-information tasking)
algorithms.result: planned: rank tentative sites by how much a high-resolution overpass would change the priority order
